title: world.shapes
description: The world's shape data, in parts: the shape index (doc index: Base64 of the deflated UTF-8 text of shape_index.json, protocol/world/shape_index.schema.json, with enc deflate; before 2026-10-15 the text itself, without enc) and the shape map (doc map: Base64 of the deflated bytes of shape_map.bin). Since 2026-10-15 a document goes out when a client asks for it (world.shapes.get, after a world.shapes.offer), not on every join. Ids, tile numbers and hashes only; never geometry or art. Sent only when the shape map's header names the published WorldIndex.

doc.description: Which document the part belongs to.

hash.description: SHA-256 of this document's whole transmitted text.

enc.description: The index document's wire form is Base64 of its deflated UTF-8 text (raw deflate). Absent on doc index: the text itself. The map is always deflated.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
